name: Erastus Snow
dateNote: Section 136 assigned him to organize a company on 14 January 1847; he became an apostle on 12 February 1849.
importance: Erastus Snow was baptized in Vermont in 1833, served many missions, and later lived at Montrose, Iowa. Section 136 tells him and Ezra T. Benson to organize a company for the trek west. He entered the Salt Lake Valley with the 1847 pioneer company. He became an apostle in 1849 and founded St. George, Utah, in 1861.
connections: Section 136 pairs him with Ezra T. Benson.

sources.title: Erastus Snow, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and roles checked on JSP. JSP gives no exact death date; it cites an obituary dated 30 May 1888, so the year is secure.
